blurb: Genetically modified transhuman warriors, Space Marines are amongst Humanity's most elite fighting forces. Angels of Death kill teams are composed of elite specialists trained in myriad forms of combat, who are capable of overcoming almost any foe.
lore: A Chapter does not assemble an Angels of Death kill team lightly. Each warrior is pulled from a different squad and a different specialism, and the roster that results is less a unit than an argument about how a particular war should be ended — a sergeant who has read the ground, a gunner who has been told which wall will not survive the hour, a sniper who has been given one name. They deploy from orbit, from a gunship's open ramp, or from a tunnel nobody thought wide enough, and they do not bring a second plan.

source.notes: Operative stats, weapon profiles, actions, ploys and equipment transcribed from Wahapedia. Ranged weapons without a printed Range rule are given range 48 (effectively unlimited on a Kill Team board). Consult the official source for the current rules: https://www.warhammer-community.com/en-gb/downloads/kill-team/

selectionRules: 1 ANGEL OF DEATH operative selected from the following list: ASSAULT INTERCESSOR SERGEANT with one option from each of the following: Hand flamer or heavy bolt pistol; Chainsword, power fist, power weapon or thunder hammer; Or the following option: Plasma pistol; chainsword; INTERCESSOR SERGEANT with one option from each of the following: Auto bolt rifle, bolt rifle or stalker bolt rifle; Chainsword, fists, power fist, power weapon or thunder hammer; SPACE MARINE CAPTAIN

5 ANGEL OF DEATH operatives selected from the following list: ASSAULT INTERCESSOR GRENADIER; ASSAULT INTERCESSOR WARRIOR; ELIMINATOR SNIPER; HEAVY INTERCESSOR GUNNER; INTERCESSOR GUNNER with auxiliary grenade launcher and one of the following options: Auto bolt rifle; fists; Bolt rifle; fists; Stalker bolt rifle; fists; INTERCESSOR WARRIOR with one of the following options: Auto bolt rifle; fists; Bolt rifle; fists; Stalker bolt rifle; fists

operatives.name: Space Marine Captain
operatives.lore: A century of command has left him with the habit of arriving where the line is about to break, and the reputation that stops it breaking. His armour is a reliquary of other people's battles; the honours are welded on because there is no longer room to hang them.

operatives.name: Assault Intercessor Sergeant
operatives.lore: He leads from the front of the charge because the charge is the order, and an order shouted from behind it carries badly. The chainsword is older than the squad and has been rebuilt twice, never replaced.

operatives.name: Intercessor Sergeant
operatives.lore: Calm to the point of coldness. He picks the firing position, tells four men where to stand, and spends the rest of the engagement making very small corrections to a plan that was right the first time.

operatives.name: Assault Intercessor Grenadier
operatives.lore: He carries the grenades because he is the one who can be trusted to judge the room before he throws into it. That judgement takes perhaps a second and a half, and he has never been asked to explain it.

operatives.name: Assault Intercessor Warrior
operatives.lore: The plain soldier of the assault squad, which is to say seven feet of ceramite that closes the distance at a dead run and does not slow down at the wall. He fights in the half-second after the pistol, and prefers it.

operatives.name: Heavy Intercessor Gunner
operatives.lore: Built heavier than his brothers and slower for it, which suits a man whose job is to stand in one place and make a corridor impassable. He counts belt links, not enemies.

operatives.name: Intercessor Gunner
operatives.lore: The squad's answer to whatever the squad cannot solve with bolt rounds — armour, a barricade, a doorway that needs to stop being one. He is used sparingly and knows it.

operatives.name: Intercessor Warrior
operatives.lore: Line infantry of the Adeptus Astartes: disciplined, unhurried, and lethal at a range most foes never reach. He has fired the same pattern of weapon for eighty years and can strip it in the dark, which he has had to do.

operatives.name: Eliminator Sniper
operatives.lore: He is already in position when the rest of the team deploys, having spent the night getting there. The cameleoline reads the light around him; the rifle reads the wind. Neither has been wrong yet.

weapons.name: Bolt sniper rifle (executioner)
weapons.rulesText: Heavy (Dash only), Saturate, Seek Light, Silent

abilities.name: OPTICS
abilities.description: Until the start of this operative's next activation, whenever it's shooting, enemy operatives cannot be obscured. This operative cannot perform this action while within control range of an enemy operative.

factionRules.name: Chapter Tactics
factionRules.description: When selecting your kill team, select a primary and secondary CHAPTER TACTIC for friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operatives to gain for the battle. Multiple instances of the same CHAPTER TACTIC aren't cumulative. Designer's Note: If you're playing a series of games, i.e. a campaign or tournament, you must select the same primary and secondary CHAPTER TACTIC for every battle (you can still change the secondary with the Adaptive Tactics strategy ploy). 1. AGGRESSIVEThis operative's melee weapons have the Rending weapon rule. 2. DUELLERWhenever this operative is fighting or retaliating, each of your normal successes can block one unresolved critical success (unless the enemy operative's weapon has the Brutal weapon rule). 3. RESOLUTEYou can ignore any changes to this operative's APL stat. and it isn't affected by enemy operatives' Shock weapon rule. 4. STEALTHYWhenever an operative is shooting this operative, if you can retain any cover saves, you can retain one additional cover save, or you can retain one cover save as a critical success instead. This isn't cumulative with improved cover saves from Vantage terrain. 5. MOBILEThis operative can perform the Fall Back action for 1 less AP.This operative can perform the Charge action while within control range of an enemy operative, and can leave that operative's control range to do so (but then normal requirements for that move apply). 6. HARDYWhenever an operative is shooting this operative, defence dice results of 5+ are critical successes. 7. SHARPSHOOTERWhenever this operative is shooting during an activation in which it hasn't performed the Charge, Fall Back or Reposition action, its bolt weapons have the Accurate 1 and Severe weapon rules 8. SIEGE SPECIALISTThis operative's ranged weapons have the Saturate weapon rule. Whenever this operative is fighting or retaliating, enemy operatives cannot assist.

factionRules.name: Astartes
factionRules.description: During each friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative's activation, it can perform either two Shoot actions or two Fight actions. If it's two Shoot actions, a bolt weapon must be selected for at least one of them, and if it's a bolt sniper rifle or heavy bolter, 1 additional AP must be spent for the second action if both actions are using that weapon. Each friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative can counteract regardless of its order.

strategicPloys.name: COMBAT DOCTRINE
strategicPloys.description: Select one COMBAT DOCTRINE from those presented below. Whenever a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative is x, its weapons have the Balanced weapon rule. X is the COMBAT DOCTRINE you selected. Devastator Doctrine: Shooting an operative more than 6" from it.Tactical Doctrine: Shooting an operative within 6" of it.Assault Doctrine: Fighting or retaliating.

hooks.notes: simulated as the Assault Doctrine; the Devastator and Tactical doctrines are not offered as a choice

strategicPloys.name: AND THEY SHALL KNOW NO FEAR
strategicPloys.description: You can ignore any changes to the stats of friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operatives from being injured (including their weapons' stats).

strategicPloys.name: ADAPTIVE TACTICS
strategicPloys.description: Change your secondary CHAPTER TACTIC. Note this ploy only lasts until the end of the turning point, at which point your original secondary CHAPTER TACTIC returns.

strategicPloys.name: INDOMITUS
strategicPloys.description: Whenever an operative is shooting a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative, if you roll two or more fails, you can discard one of them to retain another as a normal success instead.

hooks.notes: printed as discarding a fail to retain another success; simulated as one defence re-roll

firefightPloys.name: ADJUST DOCTRINE
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy during a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative's activation, before or after it performs an action. If you've used the COMBAT DOCTRINE strategy ploy during this turning point, change the COMBAT DOCTRINE you selected.

firefightPloys.name: TRANSHUMAN PHYSIOLOGY
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when an operative is shooting a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative, in the Roll Defence Dice step. You can retain one of your normal successes as a critical success instead.

hooks.notes: printed as upgrading a normal save to a critical; simulated as an extra defence dice

firefightPloys.name: SHOCK ASSAULT
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative is performing the Fight action during an activation in which it performed the Charge action, at the start of the Resolve Attack Dice step. Until the end of that action: Its melee weapon has the Shock weapon rule. The first time you strike during that sequence, inflict 1 additional damage (to a maximum of 7).

hooks.notes: the extra point of damage on the first strike is not simulated

firefightPloys.name: WRATH OF VENGEANCE
firefightPloys.description: Use this firefight ploy when a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative is counteracting. It can perform an additional 1AP action for free during that counteraction, but both actions must be different.

equipment.name: PURITY SEALS
equipment.description: Once per turning point, when a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative is shooting, fighting or retaliating, if you roll two or more fails, you can discard one of them to retain another as a normal success instead.

equipment.name: CHAPTER RELIQUARIES
equipment.description: You can use the Wrath of Vengeance firefight ploy for 0CP if the specified friendly operative has an Engage order.

equipment.name: TILTING SHIELDS
equipment.description: Once per turning point, when a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative is fighting or retaliating, after your opponent rolls their attack dice, but before re-rolls, you can use this rule. If you do, your opponent cannot retain attack dice results of less than 6 as critical successes during that sequence (e.g. as a result of the Lethal, Rending or Severe weapon rules).

equipment.name: AUSPEX
equipment.description: Once per turning point, when a friendly ANGEL OF DEATH operative performs the Shoot action and you're selecting a valid target, you can use this rule. If you do, until the end of the activation/counteraction, enemy operatives within 8" of that friendly operative cannot be obscured.

ruleHooks.notes: the bolt-weapon requirement and the extra AP for a second bolt sniper rifle or heavy bolter Shoot are not enforced
